nodes.label: docker-compose.yml (production stack: Postgres + FastAPI + nginx SPA + Caddy)
nodes.rationale: Without a domain (SITE_ADDRESS unset or ':80'), Caddy serves plain HTTP on port 80 — how the first bare-IP deploy works before DNS is configured.

nodes.label: docker-compose.yml service: backend (FastAPI)
nodes.rationale: Fails fast without SECRET_KEY/SETUP_TOKEN when DEBUG=false (${VAR:?...} interpolation). COOKIE_SECURE only set true once Caddy with a real domain is in front.

nodes.label: docker-compose.yml service: frontend (nginx static SPA)
nodes.rationale: VITE_SENTRY_DSN passed as a build ARG (not environment) because Vite bakes VITE_* vars into the bundle at `npm run build` time; changing the DSN requires a rebuild, not just a restart.

nodes.label: docker-compose.yml service: caddy (TLS terminator, ports 80/443)
nodes.rationale: Healthcheck hits the Caddy admin API (:2019, localhost-only) which is always up regardless of SITE_ADDRESS/domain/HTTPS state — a topology-independent liveness check.

nodes.label: docker-compose.yml service: backup-local (daily pg_dump, bind-mounted)
nodes.rationale: Bind-mount (./backups), not a named volume, so backups are visible/retrievable from outside Docker (e.g. rsync/scp offsite).

nodes.label: docker-compose.yml service: backup-s3 (optional S3 backup, profile-gated)
nodes.rationale: Behind the 's3-backup' compose profile so it doesn't crash on every cron run when S3_BACKUP_* env vars are unset by default.

nodes.label: Backend healthcheck uses 127.0.0.1, not localhost
nodes.rationale: In containers running as an unprivileged user, the image entrypoint can't always configure the IPv6 listener (no rights to rewrite the root config); 'localhost' resolves to ::1 first and gets connection refused even though the service listens on IPv4. Verified live on this stack. curl/wget aren't in python:3.14-slim, so the healthcheck uses python's own urllib instead.
